instructions.text: In a bowl, mix the oats, salt, and almond milk.
Stir in the grated carrot, sweetener, cinnamon, and cottage cheese until well combined.
Transfer to a glass dish or bowl, cover, and refrigerate for at least a few hours (overnight for best results).
Before serving, top with peanut butter and a sprinkle of cinnamon.
(Optional) Add a dollop of yoghurt and crushed pecans for extra flavour.
